First stable release with a more complete settings experience, improved macOS integration, and a broader internal cleanup.

## Highlights

- Added a dedicated settings window with organized panes for general behavior, appearance, notifications, and app information.
- Added launch-at-login support.
- Added poll-on-menu-open behavior.
- Added keyboard navigation and native app commands for Settings and Quit.
- Improved the menu bar label rendering and adaptive colors for light/dark menu bar appearances.
- Refined the app's visual design and native feel on macOS Sequoia and Tahoe.
- Updated the menu actions into reusable, clearer UI components.
- Added a Codex logo asset and refreshed the About pane.
- Added latest-release checking through GitHub.
- Prevented multiple settings windows from opening at the same time.
- Split large models, services, menu actions, settings views, and tests into smaller focused files.
- Greatly expanded test coverage across launcher behavior, auth, formatting, release checking, preferences, notifications, usage services, and view model behavior.
